$schema: Nusuk DL template contract v1 (see 14-templates-and-patterns.md; DESIGN.md › M9T)
name: Cancellation
job: Cancel a request with a clear reason and a clear refund.
useFor: Cancelling a paid request that can still be cancelled.
notFor: Returns after fulfilment, or removing an item from a cart.

forbidden: A title borrowed from another service.

allowed: ReasonSelection (‼️ Status Handlers › Reason Selection): one card row per reason, at least 48 high; «أسباب أخرى» opens the Text Area.
PaymentDetails · Refund: amount, method and time.
forbidden: A refund amount that changes after confirmation.
Fees that were not stated before.

allowed: One destructive Secondary (Fate) that names the outcome.
forbidden: A Primary for the destructive action.

rules: Say what happens to the money before the person confirms.
The destructive action is never the Primary (M9 Buttons).
No retention tricks: no offers, no loss framing (M4).
The sheet traps focus and returns it on close (M10).
After cancelling, the request shows Cancelled with its refund state.

allocation.App level: L3 · a task, then a confirmation sheet and a notice.
allocation.Band and tier: Band 2, commitment state. The result is a T1 notice.
allocation.Overlays: Confirmation: StatusSheet · template refund (the refund method in its slot) or wallet-refund, Fate on the cancel action only. Result: NoticeBar · Success, then back to the request.
allocation.Withheld: P0 for Dependents and Organised groups.

notes: Overlays: the example confirms with StatusSheet · template wallet-refund (General Bottom Sheet › Wallet Refund).
example.inTheFlowToday: The confirm action is a Primary, and the sheet title names electric cart tickets.
